# firebaseappdistribution_group (Data Source)

Reads an existing Firebase App Distribution tester group, for example one created in the Firebase console, so that its alias can be referenced without importing it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "firebaseappdistribution_group" "qa" {
  group_id = "qa"
}

output "qa_tester_count" {
  value = data.firebaseappdistribution_group.qa.tester_count
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) Alias of the group.

### Optional

- `project` (String) Firebase project ID or number. Defaults to the provider `project`.

### Read-Only

- `display_name` (String) Human readable name shown in the Firebase console.
- `id` (String) Full resource name of the group, in the form `projects/{project_number}/groups/{group_id}`.
- `invite_link_count` (Number) Number of invite links for the group.
- `name` (String) Full resource name of the group as returned by the API. Same as `id`.
- `release_count` (Number) Number of releases the group has access to.
- `tester_count` (Number) Number of testers in the group.
